$comment: The kit's schema registry (docs/CONSTITUTION.md §2): every bundled schema and contract, by name. `schema` in kit.canon.json names one of these (or an $id, or a repo path). packages/core/test/schema.test.mjs checks every entry: file exists, $id ends with the file path, title is kit.<name>.v1 (or the contract's own), the schema compiles. Real artefacts are validated by kit.canon.json (`kit check schemas`), not by copies.

schemas.name: canon
schemas.describes: kit.canon.json at a repository root

schemas.name: copy-pack
schemas.describes: a module's reader-facing copy as validated data (locale packs, notice packs, name tables)
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check hardcoding

schemas.name: canon-allow
schemas.describes: canon.allow.json, the reviewed hardcoding allow-list

schemas.name: visual-qa
schemas.describes: the report of kit site visual-qa, the rendered gate of the colour canon

schemas.name: search-qa
schemas.describes: search-qa.json of a site: the typed queries added to the ones kit site search-qa derives from the index

schemas.name: search-qa-report
schemas.describes: the report of kit site search-qa, the rendered gate of the global search

schemas.name: spelling-exceptions
schemas.describes: spelling.exceptions.json, a British English project's reviewed American-spelled phrases (names, titles, protocol values)
schemas.gate: kit check spelling, kit check podcast

schemas.name: projects
schemas.describes: the project registry (names, domains, prefixes)

schemas.name: theme-sources
schemas.describes: packages/core/registry/themes/sources.json, the provenance of each organisation's vendored diagram theme

schemas.name: kit-config
schemas.describes: kit.config.js default export

schemas.name: directory-v2
schemas.describes: kit.directory.v2: role-only, machine-readable directory categories without resolved brand colour literals

schemas.name: site-config
schemas.describes: site.config.js default export

schemas.name: comms-config
schemas.describes: comms.config.js default export (every email template's contract)

schemas.name: legal-notices
schemas.describes: a project's legal notices object

schemas.name: lead-forms
schemas.describes: a project's lead forms (src/forms.js FORMS)

schemas.name: forms-config
schemas.describes: the forms block of a project's comms config: declared forms and their owner (secret name of the recipients)

schemas.name: form-notification
schemas.describes: one form submission and its two deliveries (receipt and owner): POST /v1/comms/submit, the comms_form_deliveries record, GET /api/forms/deliveries

schemas.name: podcast-config
schemas.describes: a project's podcast.config.json (voices, pacing, schedule, provenance policy, covers)

schemas.name: podcast-episode
schemas.describes: an episode spec (episodeFromItem output) queued by the cron

schemas.name: content-tags
schemas.describes: a project's content-tag vocabulary (tags.config.json): id, label per locale, group, colour role, description; series, episodes and posts name tags from it only

schemas.name: podcast-provenance
schemas.describes: podcast_episodes.provenance_json, the pipeline provenance record
schemas.gate: createEpisode, the monitor and the database trigger

schemas.name: podcast-drill
schemas.describes: the proof of a publish drill (kit podcast drill), recorded as a drill of kind publish
schemas.gate: kit podcast drill, kit check resilience

schemas.name: plugin-manifest
schemas.describes: plugins/<prefix>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json

schemas.name: plugin-marketplace
schemas.describes: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json of a project

schemas.name: holiday-pack
schemas.describes: one market's holiday pack (calendar/markets)

schemas.name: diagram-theme
schemas.describes: the %%{init}%% JSON of every Mermaid diagram (theme.init line 1)

schemas.name: openapi
schemas.describes: an OpenAPI 3.1 contract (structural minimum)

schemas.name: mcp-tool
schemas.describes: one MCP tool definition (tools/list)

schemas.name: api-meta
schemas.describes: GET /api/meta body (kit.api-meta.v1)

schemas.name: webhook-event
schemas.describes: the signed webhook envelope (kit.webhook-event.v1)

schemas.name: compile-report
schemas.describes: an agent-plugin compile report (kit.compile-report.v1)

schemas.name: plugin-learning
schemas.describes: one line of <prefix>-out/learnings.jsonl (kit.plugin-learning.v1)

schemas.name: terminal-notify
schemas.describes: assets["terminal.js"].data.notify of a site project (the notify view's scenarios)

schemas.name: taxonomy
schemas.describes: a site's information architecture as rules: sections, groups, facets (the input of the page registry)

schemas.name: page-registry
schemas.describes: the generated registry of every page of a site (kit buildRegistry); menu, hubs, crumbs, related, sitemap, llms.txt and search derive from it

schemas.name: search-index
schemas.describes: /search-index.json, written by kit site build for every kit site: pages, body terms, sections, facets, synonyms, per-page weights (version 2)

schemas.name: search-config
schemas.describes: project.search in site.config.js: excluded pages, sections, facets and synonyms for the global search

schemas.name: widgets-spec
schemas.describes: widgets.spec.json of a project: audiences, use cases, scenarios, sources; usage, application, architecture and utility per widget (docs/WIDGETS.md)

schemas.name: widgets-generated
schemas.describes: widgets.generated.json, written by kit widgets build (never by hand)

schemas.name: vocabularies
schemas.describes: packages/widgets/registry/vocabularies.json: marks only one project may use, beyond the project registry's names
schemas.gate: kit check schemas (kit), kit widgets check

schemas.name: vendor-manifest
schemas.describes: <path>.manifest.json of a vendored kit snapshot (commit, sha256 per file)

schemas.name: sdk-config
schemas.describes: kit.sdk.json: the SDKs @saasreport/forge generates from every OpenAPI contract (docs/SDK.md)

schemas.name: sdk-manifest
schemas.describes: forge.manifest.json of a generated SDK (contract sha256, @saasreport/forge version and origin, sha256 per file)

schemas.name: claude-policy
schemas.describes: claude.policy.json: the Claude Code token-cost standard (kit defaults in registry/claude.policy.json; a project's overrides, within the schema's bounds)
schemas.gate: kit check claude (kit check canon), kit claude sync

schemas.name: forge-origin
schemas.describes: ORIGIN.json of @saasreport/forge: the upstream origin commit and every upstream file, ported or not, with its sha256

schemas.name: decide-config
schemas.describes: decide.config.json: typed-decision backends (System One endpoints) and the escalation threshold

schemas.name: decide-gate
schemas.describes: packages/decide/gates/*.json: a gate's typed questions and when the big model reads

schemas.name: decide-eval
schemas.describes: packages/decide/eval/*.json: labelled states for a gate, with provenance
schemas.gate: kit check schemas (kit), kit decide eval

schemas.name: decision
schemas.describes: kit.decision.v1: decide() request and result (contract of @saasreport/decide)

schemas.name: fa-rules
schemas.describes: a Persian rule pack (@saasreport/fa-lint rules/*.json, a project's own): lexicon classes, rules, fail/pass examples

schemas.name: persian-config
schemas.describes: persian.config.json: a project's Persian sources, classes, podcast scripts, allow-list and review gate

schemas.name: approval-ledger
schemas.describes: the one approval ledger: append-only, hash-chained, Ed25519-signed sign-offs (Shariah concepts, Persian native review)
schemas.gate: kit check shariah-review, kit check fa-review, kit check canon

schemas.name: trust-record
schemas.describes: the owner-signed trust record of a project: ledger paths, kinds, anchors, bootstrap rosters, the one allowed migration, the witness start

schemas.name: trust-pin
schemas.describes: KIT_TRUST_PIN: the out-of-repository minimum record seq, verifier and witness per project

schemas.name: concept-catalogue
schemas.describes: a concept catalogue: the one source of a daily concept series (definitions, sources with exact quotes, accuracy, episode beats)

schemas.name: concept-schedule
schemas.describes: the append-only order of a concept series (which concept on which day)

schemas.name: concepts-config
schemas.describes: concepts.config.json: series, episode format and size, spoken glue, gates, order and runway of a concept series

schemas.name: diagram
schemas.describes: the `%% kit:diagram {...}` header of every diagram source (id, lineage, relationships, depicts)
schemas.gate: kit diagrams check, kit check diagrams

schemas.name: diagram-externals
schemas.describes: docs/diagrams/externals.json: diagram ids of other repositories that diagram headers may refer to
schemas.gate: kit diagrams check, kit check diagrams

schemas.name: upload-record
schemas.describes: the Evidence record of one upload (@saasreport/uploads)

schemas.name: upload-policy
schemas.describes: what one form accepts as a file: types, caps, retention, the needs_sandbox decision
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check canon

schemas.name: uploads-config
schemas.describes: uploads.config.json: project, quarantine and released buckets, one UploadPolicy per form
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check canon

schemas.name: upload-error
schemas.describes: the refusal body of a form or webhook intake (@saasreport/uploads)

schemas.name: curve-input
schemas.describes: a rate curve for the simulation engines: zero, par (bootstrapped) or NSS

schemas.name: cashflow-ladder
schemas.describes: a banking-book repricing ladder (assets and liabilities in minor units) for the IRRBB engine

schemas.name: sim-scenario
schemas.describes: one scenario for a @saasreport/sim engine (engine, seed, as-of, source kind, inputs)

schemas.name: sim-run
schemas.describes: the record of one engine run: inputs hash, seed, engine version, outputs, assumptions, validation status

schemas.name: sim-result
schemas.describes: a simulation result with a SourceEnvelope-aligned provenance block for workbench badges

schemas.name: sim-origin
schemas.describes: packages/sim/ORIGIN.json: inspiring repositories, licences, what was not taken, the standards implemented

schemas.name: sim-irrbb-params
schemas.describes: the IRRBB standard as data: shock sizes, buckets, rotation coefficients, outlier threshold

schemas.name: sim-factor-table
schemas.describes: a reference table of a published standard as data for @saasreport/sim: every row with its paragraph and the standard's bounds

schemas.name: sim-profile
schemas.describes: a jurisdiction profile for @saasreport/sim: national options as bounded overrides of table rows

schemas.name: sim-outputs
schemas.describes: the outputs of every @saasreport/sim engine, one definition each, enforced at emit by kit.sim-run.v1

schemas.name: constitution-rules
schemas.describes: constitution.rules.json: the ONE registry of a project's constitutional rules, read by every enforcement layer (kit defaults in registry/constitution.rules.json; a project only adds)
schemas.gate: kit check enforcement (kit check canon), kit agent-guard sync

schemas.name: resilience
schemas.describes: resilience.json: monitors (notify, own database, stale window, dead-man), alert routes, backups, drills with proof

schemas.name: agent-identities
schemas.describes: agent-identities.json: kit principal ids, per-agent public keys and GitHub App identities of the agents of a project
schemas.gate: kit check enforcement (kit check canon), kit agent-guard identity

schemas.name: broker-config
schemas.describes: one project's agent credential broker: the GitHub App, repositories, agents (kit id, Ed25519 key, actions) and the merge rule (@saasreport/broker)
schemas.gate: kit test (packages/broker), the broker Worker on start

schemas.name: broker-request
schemas.describes: a signed agent request to the broker (token or merge, with the independent review)

schemas.name: broker-evidence
schemas.describes: one hash-chained evidence record of the broker: every authenticated allow and deny, never a token

schemas.name: work-order
schemas.describes: what a piece of work is before any code exists: goal, contracts, invariants, paths, gates, must-fail tests and approvals (docs/CONSTITUTION.md §10)

schemas.name: finding-class
schemas.describes: the registry of finding classes, each refused at t=0 by a gate proven on its real case (docs/CONSTITUTION.md §10)

schemas.name: finding-case
schemas.describes: findings/<class>/must-fail/<case>/source.json: where a must-fail case comes from, blob by blob

schemas.name: handwritten-ledger
schemas.describes: the canon checks' modules: the engine, or a hand-written check frozen on 2026-10-07 with the work order that migrates it (wo-0016)

schemas.name: ci-rerun-verdict
schemas.describes: kit ci unstarted: whether a failed CI run is re-run once because none of its failed jobs ever started (a CI provider outage), and why
schemas.gate: kit ci unstarted (validates its own output) and packages/cli/test/ci.test.mjs

schemas.name: ci-hold-verdict
schemas.describes: kit ci hold: whether a scheduled run is held because the newest decided run of the same workflow at the same head failed (an unchanged cause is not failed and mailed again every tick), and why
schemas.gate: kit ci hold (validates its own output), templates/ci/scheduled-hold.yml and packages/cli/test/ci.test.mjs

schemas.name: kit-source
schemas.describes: the kit at t=0: what scripts/kit.mjs verified before a use of the kit (the checkout at vendor.path is the kit's published head, clean, installed, linked); kit source and kit check canon (vendor, source mode) read it
schemas.gate: templates/site/scripts/kit.mjs (writes it), kit check canon vendor in source mode (validates it), packages/cli/test/source.test.mjs

schemas.name: directory
schemas.describes: directory/directory.json, the public machine-readable actor directory of a site (data, never CSS)

schemas.name: upload-evidence
schemas.describes: one system action on an upload, appended to the evidence log (@saasreport/uploads)

schemas.name: upload-lifecycle
schemas.describes: the upload lifecycle table (packages/uploads/lifecycle.json): states, actors, operations and the only transitions the engine allows
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check canon, kit test (packages/uploads)

schemas.name: regex-linear
schemas.describes: the reviewed list of regexes allowed outside packages/uploads/src (packages/uploads/test/regex-linear.json)
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check canon, kit test (packages/uploads)

schemas.name: upload-serve
schemas.describes: the response headers of a released upload: sniffed content type, nosniff, attachment unless the policy declares the kind inline-safe, the image CSP when inline (@saasreport/uploads)

schemas.name: toolchain
schemas.describes: packages/core/registry/toolchain.json, the one pin of node, npm and git
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check staleness

schemas.name: staleness-registry
schemas.describes: packages/core/registry/staleness.json, the names kit check staleness reads
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check staleness

schemas.name: dated-registry
schemas.describes: a registry of facts read from outside: max_age_days and a verified day per fact

schemas.name: staleness-report
schemas.describes: the report of kit check staleness --json

schemas.name: worktrees
schemas.describes: scratch/worktrees.json, the machine's worktree registry (path, repo, branch, owner, last_sync)

schemas.name: staleness-obligations
schemas.describes: packages/core/registry/staleness-obligations.json, what docs/FRESHNESS.md owes
schemas.gate: kit check schemas, kit check staleness (test)

schemas.name: release
schemas.describes: release.json at a repository root: the one production workflow's project facts (build, databases, Workers in order, owner address, drills, bootstrap state)

schemas.name: governance
schemas.describes: governance.json, the declared review requirements of the generated default-branch ruleset (approvals, code-owner review, last-push approval, independent-review marker)

schemas.name: release-workers
schemas.describes: the answer of kit release workers --json: the project and the Workers release.json deploys, by name (the central deployer's one source of Worker names)

schemas.name: release-bootstrap
schemas.describes: release/bootstrap.json, the receipt of a bootstrap production run
schemas.gate: kit check release, kit release bootstrap

schemas.name: build
schemas.describes: the answer of GET /api/build on every deployed Worker (the commit it serves)

schemas.name: health
schemas.describes: the answer of GET /api/health on a kit site Worker, derived from its monitor

schemas.name: kit-head
schemas.describes: kit-main.json, the published head of the kit's main (vendor-stale)

schemas.name: kit-head-registry
schemas.describes: packages/core/registry/kit-head.json, where the kit's main head is published

schemas.name: legacy-migration-comments
schemas.describes: the kit-shipped migrations excused from the comment rule, by sha256
schemas.gate: kit check migrations, kit check schemas

schemas.name: d1-unsupported
schemas.describes: what remote D1 refuses that stock SQLite runs (statements, functions, virtual tables, pragmas), each with its Cloudflare source
schemas.gate: kit check migrations, kit check schemas

schemas.name: podcast-drill-config
schemas.describes: the parameters of the publish drill: child environment allow-list, search horizon, hours, time limit

schemas.name: migration-order-source
schemas.describes: the wrangler version and comparator the kit's migration order mirrors

schemas.name: capability-manifest
schemas.describes: contracts/capabilities.json, the canonical X-as-Code and X-as-a-Service registry with API/Forge SDK/widget parity and Failure-First promotion evidence
schemas.gate: kit check contracts and kit check schemas

schemas.name: universal-envelope
schemas.describes: kit.universal-envelope.v1 immutable T=0 transport for all typed content, event, media, API, workflow, SDK/widget and release lifecycles; domain payload contracts remain authoritative

schemas.name: universal-boundaries
schemas.describes: kit.universal-boundaries.v1 declares all 47 T=0 universal system boundaries and exact failure-first gate requirements across surface, widget, app, API, SDK, environment, tenant, product, agent, engine, daemon, rail, Workflows, storage, content and release

schemas.name: media-bundle
schemas.describes: One canonical typed content payload for podcast, infographic, blog and clip projections under the universal T=0 envelope, without a second lifecycle/authority contract
